channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jaden Springer | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jaden Springer from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevin O'Connor on Jaden Springer
item.description:
Yahoo Sports’ Kevin O’Connor discussed the Celtics showcasing their backup guard, Springer, in an attempt to strike a deal before next month’s deadline, per The Kevin O’Connor Show.

“I’ve heard that they’re open to trading [Celtics] Jaden Springer. He’s been playing lately. I’d imagine that they’re trying to feature him to increase his value,”

Kevin O'Connor on Jaden Springer, Jan 29, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Jaden Springer
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Daryl Morey, on trading Jaden Springer:

“Our evaluation was that his timetable to help a playoff team is farther out than what the second round pick can do for us.”

Daryl Morey on Jaden Springer, Feb 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Jaden Springer
item.description:
Noah Levick:Doc Rivers on Jaden Springer:

“I’m telling you, he’s going to be an elite defensive player in our league.”

Doc Rivers on Jaden Springer, Mar 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @NoahLevick.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Coby Karl, Jaden Springer
item.description:
Keith Pompey:Doc Rivers on Jaden Springer:

“Just trying to find a position where he can fit in. I think here [The Sixers NBA G-League facility] will be big for him... I think [Sixers G-League coach] Coby [Karl] is gonna be great for Jaden and all the young guys as well.”

Doc Rivers on Coby Karl, Jaden Springer, Oct 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.
